Unfortunately, our databank had a 'accident', and I need to ask you some questions to fill in the blanks.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Ogo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Ogo''' was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Mos Eisley Police Authority|Mos Eisley Police]] and served as planetary record keeper.<ref name="SWG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMosEisleyPoliceOfficer.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Ogo]]
Lt. Ogo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Ogo spawned under the generic "mos_eisley_police_officer" template, his gender and appearance were randomized under one of fifteen possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG" /> Lt. Ogo was one of the "planet record keeper" NPCs added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 6 Notes: 11 February 04|Publish 6]]" update, released on [[February 11]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60893|text=Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown}}</ref> These NPCs permitted to reset player quest progression status on the planets they were located. Ogo therefore allowed players to repeat pre-[[W:c:swg:Combat Upgrade|CU]] quests on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG" />
